def factor_range_compression_vol_gate(df):
    """ATR compression signal, attenuated in low-volume periods."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    tr = np.maximum(high - low, np.abs(high - prev_close), np.abs(low - prev_close))
    tr_ema_short = tr.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    tr_ema_long = tr.ewm(span=50, adjust=False).mean()
    ratio = tr_ema_short / tr_ema_long.replace(0, np.nan)
    raw_factor = -ratio
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    factor = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, raw_factor, raw_factor * 0.7)
    df_copy["factor_range_compression_vol_gate"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_compression_vol_gate"]
description: Core mechanism: short-term EMA of true range divided by long-term EMA, inverted to capture volatility compression. The child adds a lightweight volume-gate modifier: when volume is not in a high regime (using classify_volume_regime tool), the signal is attenuated by 0.7 to reduce noise from low-volume periods, improving robustness and preserving the parent’s strong rank stability and MI. One core mechanism (compression) with one auxiliary modifier (volume gate).
